WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT m.zoneref, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS avg_faces
  FROM scanmesh AS m
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref
  GROUP BY m.zoneref, s.entrystat
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_faces) AS overall_avg
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT s1.zoneref, s1.entrystat, s1.avg_faces,
         s1.avg_faces - s2.overall_avg AS diff
  FROM step1 AS s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 AS s2
  WHERE s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_faces) AS status_avg
  FROM step3
  GROUP BY entrystat
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT s3.zoneref, s3.entrystat, s3.avg_faces, s3.diff,
         s3.avg_faces - s4.status_avg AS excess
  FROM step3 AS s3
  JOIN step4 AS s4 ON s3.entrystat = s4.entrystat
  WHERE s3.avg_faces > s4.status_avg
)
SELECT AVG(avg_faces), AVG(diff), AVG(excess)
FROM step5
